verdict.rationale: Factory's docs show diffs of Droid's changes: full code diffs render beside the session, inline line-by-line review comments are supported, and Droid shows what will be modified before applying anything. The CLI also mentions approvals, and you can review the diff and merge from the App or terminal. None of this explicitly documents an approval gate that controls whether changes become a pull request. missing for 10: explicit documented approve-before-PR-creation gate, independent or hands-on corroboration of the diff-review-then-PR flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review a diff of an agent's changes and approve it before it becomes a pull request

citations.quote: Delegate a task, review the diff, and merge from the App or your terminal.
Droid analyzes your codebase, proposes changes, and shows what will be modified before applying anything.
inline code review comments on a diff line by line. Droid acts on the feedback in place.
full code diffs render beside the session that produced them.
interactive terminal UI with project context, approvals, MCP tools, Missions, and headless execution.
